items.title: Warren Buffett donates $5.5 billion to charity, urging kindness
items.summary: Buffett, who stepped down as Berkshire Hathaway's chairman in September, said the gift will be directed to four foundations.

items.title: Buffett Donates $5.5 Billion in Berkshire Stock to Family Foundations as Gifts Increase
items.summary: The former Berkshire CEO and chairman also said his confidence in Berkshire “is as strong as ever.”

items.title: Warren Buffett Sold More Than Half His Bank of America Stock. Monday Could Reveal Another Big Move
items.summary: Berkshire has trimmed its once-prized Bank of America stake for two straight years, and a quiet clue buried in its latest quarterly report suggests the selling never stopped. One SEC filing due Monday will show how far it went.

items.title: Berkshire Hathaway Hits an All-Time High: Here’s What $10,000 Invested a Year Ago Is Worth Now
items.summary: Berkshire shrugged off the Buffett exit slump and now sits at a record while the S&P 500 stumbles. Greg Abel's cash deployment explains part of the rally, but one warning sign in the numbers could complicate the story.

items.title: Warren Buffett Donating $5.4 Billion of Berkshire Hathaway Stock to Family Foundations
items.summary: Warren Buffett is making his annual Thanksgiving donation of stock, giving nearly $5.4 billion worth of Berkshire Hathaway shares to four family foundations.

items.title: Warren Buffett donates more Berkshire shares, confidence in successors 'as strong as ever'
items.summary: Nov 16 () - Warren Buffett said on Monday he is donating about $5.47 ‌billion of his Berkshire Hathaway ‌shares to four charities led by his adult ​children, while saying his confidence in the new leadership of the conglomerate he built over 60 years remains "as strong as ‌ever.

items.title: Warren Buffett Donates 9.2 Million Berkshire Shares to Family Foundations
items.summary: Warren Buffett is donating 9.2 million of Berkshire Hathaway's Class B shares to his family's four charitable foundations, in keeping with his plan to give away all of his Berkshire stock over the next decade.
